name: Newer features
why: How a new Claude Code feature is tried, measured and kept or dropped
ideal: A new feature is read, tried on one thread, measured, then kept or dropped with a note.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Manage multiple agents with agent view
Claude Code Docs: Keep Claude working toward a goal
Claude Code Docs: Configure auto mode

steps.name: Read changelog
steps.rule: Each new feature is read in the changelog before a thread tries it.

steps.name: Try on one thread
steps.rule: One long thread tries the feature with a clear condition.

steps.name: Measure
steps.rule: Prompts and nudges are counted for that thread.

steps.name: Keep or drop
steps.rule: A feature that lowers prompts and nudges is kept; the rest is dropped.

steps.name: Note
steps.rule: The decision and its reason are saved to project memory.
